dialog.body: Hello, thank you for contacting Old Stone Auto Insurance. My name is Roy Jenkins. May I please have your name?
Hello, my name is Carol Turner.
Thank you, Carol. Could you please provide me with your policy number?
Sure, my policy number is one two three four five.
Great, thank you. Can you also confirm the make and model of your vehicle?
Of course, I drive a Honda Civic.
Thank you for the information, Carol. Is there a specific reason for your call today?
Yes, I'd like to inquire about adding roadside assistance to my policy.
I can assist you with that. Let me check the available options for you.
Thank you for your time, Carol. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
